name: Cluj Hills
summary: Cluj-Napoca, called simply Cluj until 1974 and in everyday language, is the seat of Cluj County, Transylvania, Romania. With 286,598 inhabitants at the 2021 census, it is the second most populous city in the country. With a history of over two millennia, the city is nicknamed the Heart of Transylvania or the Treasure City.
